text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Even though conditions for democratic elections do not exist, Bosnian parliament urges voters to cast their votes on Saturday. It was the last parliament session before a new central body is formed after September 14 elections.
- Bosnian PTT will charge 1,000 DEM for a mobile telephone connection, the newspaper says.
- U.S. firm Brown and Root sign a memorandum of understanding with Bosnia's Unis Holding, pledging technical aid and menagement consulting. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
